'''2009 Worlds Team Tournament M Glenn LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[M Glenn]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Username:''' DECK
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
